scenes.label: body lengths per second in a courtship dive
scenes.body: Male Anna's hummingbird, about 27 m/s at top speed.

scenes.headline: Force on the bird as it pulls out of the dive

caption:
Animal athletes, episode 2: the tiny one.

To measure it, Clark filmed 26 courtship dives with high-speed cameras in California.

Source: Clark 2009, Proceedings of the Royal Society B; National Geographic. Photos/video: Wikimedia Commons (credits on screen).
notes: Fitness PR/record format applied to a peer-reviewed animal record; length-specific speed comparison makes it surprising, and only Anna's hummingbird photos are used.
